name: x0-navigator
description: Read-only code navigation for bim-ootb, answered from the repo's own generated files: where an APP field is set, and which rule a §TAG stands for. No AI, no network, no dependencies.

commands.title: X0 Navigator: Cost if deployed (start-up and offline-cache bytes vs main)
X0 Navigator: Open the log line behind a value
X0 Navigator: Run local (serve the repo, show each app's URL and version on disk)
X0 Navigator: Check (syntax, precache audit, cache-version bump)
X0 Navigator: Fetch back (is the live site on main? uses the network)

bimDevtools.compilerRoot.description: Path to the bim-compiler checkout, whose prompts/ and docs/ are also searched for §TAGs. Empty = a sibling folder ../bim-compiler next to bim-ootb.

bimDevtools.costBaseRef.description: The git ref "Cost if deployed" compares the working tree against.

bimDevtools.liveSite.description: The live site "Fetch back" reads. Empty = derived from the git remote (https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>).
